description: Poll the alerts view of a registered watch: the filings matching the watch's own rules that this service first saw since the cursor — new filings, /A amendments grouped to their base form, and deletion flags from weekly index reconciliation only. Paid via x402: $0.01 — RULED (10000 USDC units / 68000 SOL lamports) per delivered view — one poll delivers ALL matching events since the cursor, up to 200 per poll; it is NOT charged per event. Always call the free preflight first (same watch_id + cursor): GET /toll/secalerts/alerts/preflight returns the pending-event count only (no event content) — pending_count 0 is the complete free answer, so you never pay for an empty view. A settled poll that still delivers zero writes exactly one refund intent (net charge zero, cursor unmoved). If you lose a response, re-poll the same cursor within 7 days: the delivery record is re-served verbatim and free (redelivered: true). first_seen_at is ExchangeRebel's own detection timestamp — the moment this service first recorded the filing in its append-only store. The SEC publishes no availability timestamp, so no seller's first-seen time can be anything other than their own observation. For a filer's first-ever touch, the store is seeded from the filer's returned history and first_seen_at is the seed time (records carry seeded:true). Deletion flags are issued only for removals confirmed by the weekly full-index reconciliation: a deletion_flag event is produced only from a record whose provenance marks it weekly-index-reconciliation-sourced. Removals noticed when a single filer's submissions record is re-read are never issued as deletion alerts by this service. Until the weekly reconciliation is wired to the live store, deletion flags do not fire in production. Honest crossover: polls cost $0.01 (ruled price) per delivered alerts view. A caller whose watches deliver about 500 events a month is spending about $5.00 a month here — the price of Datamule's $5/month subscription — and continuous, high-volume watchers are better served by that subscription. This service is built for episodic, task-driven agent queries: register a watch, poll it when the task needs the answer, and pay only for delivered views. Price: $0.01 per call (per delivered alerts view). — USDC on Solana via x402 (over MCP: call without payment to get the PaymentRequired challenge, then retry with the payment at _meta["x402/payment"]). HTTP equivalent: GET https://exchangerebel.com/toll/secalerts/alerts.

cursor.description: Optional opaque cursor from a prior poll's next_cursor (or the registration initial_cursor); omit for the watch's initial cursor. A cursor bound to a different watch is refused free (bad_cursor).

watch_id.description: The bearer credential issued by sec_alerts_register_watch.
